children: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. Sponsored ADR (BME:BBVA) reported a CET1 ratio of 12.21% in Q3 2026, down 69 basis points quarter over quarter but above its 11.5%–12% target range. Global Transaction Banking revenue rose 21% to €2.484 billion in the first nine months of 2026.
: BBVA’s CET1 ratio fell 69 basis points quarter over quarter to 12.21% at Q3 2026, above its 11.5%–12% target range. A €1 billion buyback drove 49 basis points of the decline.
: BBVA issued $2.05 billion in senior non-preferred bonds across three tranches, including $1 billion due in 2036. Demand was nearly five times the offer, supporting its 2027 funding plan.
: BBVA CIB’s Global Transaction Banking revenue climbed 21% year over year to €2.484 billion in the first nine months of 2026. Third-quarter net interest income and fees hit quarterly highs.
: BBVA’s Investment Banking & Finance revenue rose 34% year over year to €1.548 billion through September 2026, while its loan book grew 32% from December 2025.
: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. Sponsored ADR (BBVA) has a planned share buyback that could retire more shares with the same budget following a decline in its share price.
: BBVA tested AI assistants that make payments for customers through existing banking systems. The trials are early, and the services are not yet widely available.
